chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated allelic effect at rs13078086
predictions: Ref and alt alleles show no reproducible allele-specific TF occupancy or enhancer activity in HCT116.
Any colorectal cancer association is explained by linkage disequilibrium with a nearby causal variant or by a passenger event, not by this base.
falsified_if: A robust ref-vs-alt difference in TF occupancy and enhancer activity is reproduced in colorectal cells.
The allelic effect is abolished by knockdown of the proposed TF.

chains.title: CDX2 binds the ref allele more strongly and activates a CCDC50 enhancer

links.claim: CDX2 is the best-supported intestinal TF for this site by motif similarity and colorectal expression; the ref T allele is predicted to bind CDX2 more strongly than the alt G allele. No CDX2 QBiC-SELEX model or ChIP data were supplied, so this is motif-based inference only.
rs13078086 lies in a putative regulatory element near CCDC50, and the ref allele is predicted to preserve higher CDX2-dependent enhancer activity.
Altered enhancer activity changes CCDC50 expression in colorectal cells; CCDC50 is the nearest plausible target at this locus.
HCT116 is a colorectal carcinoma line with intestinal TF expression, making CDX2-dependent regulation plausible in this context.
Lower CDX2-dependent CCDC50 enhancer activity in carriers of the alt allele may modestly alter colorectal cancer cell behavior.

predictions: Ref allele shows higher CDX2 ChIP signal than alt allele in HCT116.
Ref allele drives higher reporter activity, and CDX2 knockdown reduces ref reporter activity toward the alt level.
CCDC50 expression correlates with the ref allele in colorectal cell models.
falsified_if: No allele-specific CDX2 occupancy is detected at the variant.
Ref and alt reporters are equal, or the difference is not CDX2-dependent.

chains.title: TCF7L2 binds the alt allele more strongly and creates a Wnt-responsive CCDC50 element

links.claim: TCF7L2 is a colorectal Wnt effector with a TCF/LEF motif related to the sequence context; the alt G allele is predicted to create or strengthen TCF7L2 binding relative to ref T. No TCF7L2 QBiC-SELEX model or ChIP data were supplied, so this is motif-based inference only.
The alt allele is predicted to increase Wnt-responsive enhancer activity at this CCDC50-associated element.
Increased enhancer activity raises CCDC50 expression in colorectal cells.
HCT116 has active Wnt signaling, so TCF7L2-dependent enhancer effects are plausible in this line.
Alt-allele-associated CCDC50 upregulation may contribute to colorectal cancer phenotypes through Wnt-linked growth effects.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher TCF7L2 ChIP signal than ref allele in HCT116.
Alt reporter is more active, and TCF7L2 knockdown reduces alt reporter activity.
Wnt stimulation increases the allelic reporter difference.
falsified_if: No allele-specific TCF7L2 occupancy is detected.
The reporter difference is not TCF7L2- or Wnt-dependent.

chains.title: FOXA1 binds the ref allele more strongly and maintains CCDC50 enhancer activity

links.claim: FOXA1 is an endoderm/colorectal lineage TF with a T-rich motif; the ref T allele is predicted to bind FOXA1 more strongly than alt G. No FOXA1 QBiC-SELEX model or ChIP data were supplied, so this is motif-based inference only.
The ref allele is predicted to preserve FOXA1-dependent enhancer activity at this CCDC50-associated element.
FOXA1-dependent enhancer activity alters CCDC50 expression in colorectal cells.
FOXA1 is expressed in colorectal epithelial cells and HCT116, making this regulatory route plausible.
Reduced FOXA1-dependent CCDC50 expression in alt carriers may modify colorectal cancer phenotypes.

predictions: Ref allele shows higher FOXA1 ChIP signal than alt allele.
Ref reporter is more active, and FOXA1 knockdown reduces ref reporter activity.
FOXA1 depletion changes CCDC50 expression in HCT116.
falsified_if: No allele-specific FOXA1 occupancy is detected.
FOXA1 knockdown does not affect the allelic reporter difference.

chains.title: CTCF binds the ref allele more strongly and alters a CCDC50 chromatin boundary
chains.element: Putative CCDC50-associated CTCF boundary element at chr3:191441666

links.claim: CTCF is a chromatin-boundary factor; the ref T allele is predicted to bind CTCF more strongly than alt G at this site. No CTCF QBiC-SELEX model or ChIP data were supplied, so this is motif-based inference only.
The variant lies in a putative CTCF boundary element whose occupancy is reduced by the alt allele.
Altered CTCF boundary activity changes CCDC50 regulatory contacts or expression in colorectal cells.
CTCF occupancy and chromatin looping are measurable in HCT116 colorectal carcinoma cells.
Disrupted CTCF-dependent CCDC50 regulation in alt carriers may contribute to colorectal cancer risk or progression.

predictions: Ref allele shows higher CTCF ChIP signal than alt allele.
Alt allele alters local chromatin contacts or CCDC50 expression without changing a simple enhancer reporter.
CTCF knockdown mimics the alt-allele chromatin state.
falsified_if: No allele-specific CTCF occupancy is detected.
Chromatin contact or expression differences do not track the allele.

matrix.test: Allele-specific enhancer reporter in HCT116 with and without CDX2 knockdown

outcomes.outcome: Ref and alt reporters are equal; no CDX2-dependent allelic effect.
Ref reporter is higher; CDX2 knockdown reduces ref toward alt.
Alt reporter is higher; TCF7L2 knockdown reduces alt.
Ref reporter is higher and FOXA1 knockdown selectively reduces ref.
No simple reporter difference, but CTCF occupancy or chromatin contacts differ by allele.

matrix.test: Allele-specific CDX2 ChIP-qPCR over rs13078086 in HCT116

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible ref-vs-alt CDX2 occupancy difference.
Ref allele shows higher CDX2 occupancy.
No CDX2 allelic difference; TCF7L2 may instead show alt-specific occupancy.
CDX2 allelic difference is absent or weaker than FOXA1 allelic difference.
No CDX2 allelic difference; CTCF shows ref-specific occupancy.

matrix.test: CRISPRi of the rs13078086 element in HCT116 followed by CCDC50 expression

outcomes.outcome: No allele-dependent change in CCDC50 expression.
Element repression lowers CCDC50 more strongly on the ref allele in a CDX2-dependent manner.
Element repression lowers CCDC50 more strongly on the alt allele in a TCF7L2-dependent manner.
Element repression lowers CCDC50 more strongly on the ref allele in a FOXA1-dependent manner.
Element repression changes chromatin contacts more than steady-state CCDC50 expression.

next_experiment: Cheapest discriminating experiment: allele-specific luciferase reporter for ref vs alt in HCT116, with and without CDX2 siRNA. A ref-higher, CDX2-dependent signal supports H1; no allelic difference supports H0.
